cues.zh: 那么光子筛是如何工作的呢？
cues.en: So how does a photon sieve work?

cues.zh: 让我先说，实际上并不是孔本身衍射
cues.en: Well let me start by saying that it is actually not the holes themselves that diffract the

cues.zh: 光，而是孔的边缘。
cues.en: light, but the edges of the holes.

cues.zh: 所以孔越大，衍射的相对量就越小，平均衍射
cues.en: So the bigger the hole, the smaller the relative amount of diffraction and the average angle

cues.zh: 角也越小。
cues.en: of diffraction.

cues.zh: 这也是为什么在所有光子筛中，孔洞从中心到边缘会越来越小
cues.en: And this is also why in all photon sieves, the holes get smaller going from the center

cues.zh: 直到筛子的外侧。
cues.en: to the outsides of the sieve.

cues.zh: 但我们先假设每个孔都充当一个衍射点源，然后
cues.en: But let's for a moment assume that each hole acts as one diffractive point source en let's

cues.zh: 假设你想要的焦点在这里。
cues.en: say your desired focal point is here.

cues.zh: 所以你可以做的是，选择每个孔的位置，使得
cues.en: So what you can do is to choose the position of each hole such that the distance between

cues.zh: 焦点与孔之间的距离是整数个波长。
cues.en: the focal point and the hole is a integer (whole) number of wavelengts.

cues.zh: 这样，从每个孔发出的波前将在焦点处同相到达。
cues.en: So the wave fronts originating from every hole will arrive in phase at the focal point.

cues.zh: 换句话说，在这个特定点上，所有波的强度会叠加，
cues.en: In other words, at this specific point, the intensities of all the waves will add up and

cues.zh: 并在局部产生相对较高的强度。
cues.en: will locally create a relatively high intensity.

cues.zh: 而在其他点上，光强实际上会大致相互抵消，因为
cues.en: And in other points, the light intensity will actually more or less average out, because

cues.zh: 有些波可能与其他孔发出的波不同相。
cues.en: some waves might be out of phase with the waves originating from other holes.
